title: 1RB1RF_1LC1RE_0LD0LC_1RD0RB_1RA0RB_1RA---: halting needs a lost race, in Lean
text: The collisions and the one-unit anomaly of 1RB1RF_1LC1RE_0LD0LC_1RD0RB_1RA0RB_1RA---, which were simulated cell by cell, are now 711 general Lean rules from a symbolic case split that also covers the end of the word, giving a closed-form macro map. The sisters' race invariant fails here, so Lean proves a weaker one (at most two misaligned gaps pending): the machine never halts unless a race is lost, and none is lost in 10^6 steps of the map.
